high_level_description: The image depicts a detailed figurine of an astronaut standing on what appears to be the surface of the moon. The astronaut is wearing a white spacesuit with a gold helmet, which reflects the surroundings, including a person taking the photo. The astronaut's left hand is raised, holding a tool or device, while the right hand rests by their side. The astronaut is positioned in front of a bookshelf filled with various books. Some of the visible titles include "Shoe Dog" by Phil Knight, "Ikigai," and others that are partially obscured.
